question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The detective went __the whole nine yards__ in his investigation.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"go the whole nine yards"** means to do everything possible or to go all the way in an effort. (पूरी कोशिश करना)

 
 
• **Example: **When planning the wedding, they went the whole nine yards, ensuring every detail was perfect.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Measuring every step** (प्रत्येक कदम को मापना): This phrase means to carefully measure or consider each step in a process.

 
 
• **Example:** The engineer measured every step to ensure the bridge's safety.
 
 
 
• **Close affinity with the law** (कानून के साथ घनिष्ठ संबंध): This phrase means to have a close relationship or connection with legal matters.
 
 
• **Example:** His close affinity with the law helped him win many cases.
 
 
 
• **Taking the distant call** (दूर की कॉल लेना): This phrase means to make a decision or take action that involves a distant or future consideration.
 
 
• **Example:** She was taking the distant call when she decided to invest in long-term stocks.
